function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

No pets on platforms. | Near the airport; pet‑friendly signage. | ### How to Travel with Pets on Miami Trains 1. **Carrier or Leash** – All pets must be in a carrier or on a leash and under the seat. 2. **No Pets on Platforms** – Pets are not permitted on the platforms or in the station concourses. 3. **Clean Up** – Owners must clean up after their pets. 4. **Check for Updates** – Policies can change; always verify before you travel. ### Where to Get More Information | Resource | Contact | |----------|---------| | **Miami-Dade Transit (Metrorail)** | Phone: 305‑445‑4000
Website: [miamidade.gov](https://www.miamidade.gov) | | **Tri‑Rail** | Phone: 305‑445‑4000 (same as Metrorail)
Website: [tri-rail.com](https://www.tri-rail.com) | | **Pet‑Friendly Travel Guides** | TripAdvisor, Yelp, or local pet‑friendly blogs often list station amenities. | ### Quick Tips - **Arrive Early** – Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet. - **Carry Essentials** – Water, a small bowl, and a waste bag are essential. - **Check for Pet‑Friendly Amenities** – Some stations have pet relief areas or nearby pet stores. If you’re planning a trip or commute, it’s a good idea to call the transit authority or check their website for the most current pet policies. Safe travels!
